Siren Isle, known as Cyrandall to the Vrykul, is a storm-wracked island. During the Fourth War, it was used by Kul Tiras to mine Azerite, but since then its inhabitants have mysteriously disappeared.
The goblins, Arathi, and earthen have all ventured there, drawn by a mysterious whispering crystal. The Bloodwake vrykul, Darktide naga, and Bilge Rats pirates vie for control of the isle.

During the [[Fourth War]], it was used by [[Kul Tiras]] to mine [[:Azerite]], but since then its inhabitants have mysteriously disappeared. The [[goblin]]s, [[Arathi Empire|Arathi]], and [[earthen]] have all ventured there, drawn by a mysterious whispering crystal.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vbXcFW7g-o0 Siren Isle Preview] The [[Bloodwake]] [[vrykul]], [[Darktide]] [[naga]], and [[Bilge Rats]] [[pirate]]s vie for control of the isle. ==History== {{Stub/Lore-section}} Around twenty thousand years ago, wishing to avoid the [[Winterskorn War]], the [[iron vrykul]] [[Cyrce]] guided the [[Sturmvyn clan]] to settle in the area they called the "Cradle of Hymosul". After the [[Great Sundering]] in 10,000 [[BDP]], the [[naga]] attacked and overwhelmed the clan, until Cyrce ordered them to retreat to their [[Forgotten Vault (Siren Isle)|Vault]].[[Glittering Ancient Tablet]] ===The War Within=== {{Tww-section}} In Year 42 [[ADP]], a [[goblin]] salvage team discovered the isle and the strange "singing crystal" at its center, leading the [[Hallowfall Arathi]], [[Khaz Algar|Algari]] [[earthen]], and [[Bilgewater Cartel|Bilgewater]]'s [[Gazlowe's Greasemonkeys|Greasemonkeys]] to form an expedition to investigate the mystery of the Siren Isle.[[The Expedition Awaits]] Among the [[Arathi]], the [[Sacredites]] were amazed to discover that the crystal, [[Lorandel]] as they named it, was just like [[Beledar]] in [[Hallowfall]].[[Almyr Sunhart#Quotes|Almyr Sunhart's gossip]] ==Getting there== Players initially get to the Siren Isle through [[The Expedition Awaits]], after which there are two ways to travel to and from the Siren quests== {{Main|Siren Isle storyline}} :The [[Hallowfall Arathi]], the [[Awakened (earthen)|Awakened]] [[earthen]] and [[Gazlowe's Greasemonkeys]] have set off to explore a mysterious island calling out across the waves. Will you join the expedition and journey to the Siren Isle?[[Adventure Guide]] description Complete a short introduction questline to unlock Siren Isle and all its activities and rewards. Enemies on the isle cycle every week from a pool of three types - [[vrykul]], [[naga]], and [[pirate]]s. After completing a weekly world quest, the [[Seafury Tempest]] phase of the Siren Isle becomes available via [[Suzie Boltwrench]] with additional quests, challenges, and more rewards. ===Flame-Blessed Iron, Cyrce's Circlet, and flying=== [[Flame-Blessed Iron]] is the main [[currency]] obtained from treasures, mobs, and doing activities on the isle and is used to buy catch-up gear from [[Argarom]], various cosmetics from [[Soweezi]], [[Hooded Purveyor]], [[Ailenda Hedgemyr]], and [[Taljori]], or extra gems for [[Cyrce's Circlet]], obtained during the main questline. Donate Flame-Blessed Iron to [[Major Excavations]] in order to start bonus objective events. Catch-up gear ilvl584 can also be obtained by killing rare enemies and completing weekly quests. Flying is initially not possible due to the presence of [[High Winds (Siren Isle)]] until [[Cyrce Would Be So Proud]]. Use convenient [[Grappling Hold|grapnel hooks]] to navigate the isle's tall bluffs or use [[Experimental Go-Pack]]. Upgrade Cyrce's Circlet via [[Raw Singing Citrine]], awarded from weekly quests, all the way up to ilvl 658 (or Hero 4 in [[The War Within Season 2]]) to be able to fly in the area when the weather is calm. ===Vignettes=== Similar to [[Zaralek Cavern]], vignettes and rare mobs are denoted by emote messages in the chat. ;Normal phase *[[Asbjorn the Bloodsoaked]] (vrykul) *[[Bloodbrine]] - {{Text|emote|A foul smell is carried on the wind from the west.}} *[[Coralweaver Calliso]] (naga) - {{Text|emote|A gurgling giggle and the sound of chains dragging across sand cuts through the seaside silence.}} *[[Chef Chum Platter]] (pirate) - {{text|emote|The sound of waves and breaking wood is carried on the wind.}} *[[Ghostmaker]] - {{Text|emote|A haunting, echoing howl rises from the hillside. A feel of unease lingers on the air.}} *[[Grimgull]] *[[Gunnlod the Sea-Drinker]] (Forgotten Vault) - {{Text|emote|The ground trembles and a chill fills the air.
